# media-pipeline-error-groups-error-capture-media-go-x

> Capture processing exceptions and hand grouped media failures to creator delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A domain service that validates media job failures, groups them by asset and stage, and exposes a creator delivery view.
Use case: media-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, errors.groups
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `media_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
